evm.title: Electronic Voting Machine (EVM)
evm.description: A device used to electronically record and count votes in elections. It consists of a Balloting Unit and a Control Unit.

vvpat.title: Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT)
vvpat.description: An independent system connected with the EVM that allows voters to verify that their votes are cast as intended.

voter_registration.title: Voter Registration
voter_registration.description: Every citizen of India who is 18 years or older on the qualifying date is eligible to be registered as a voter.
